You can find product information about the firmware update for [product_name] addressing security issue CVE-2020-7593. If you've downloaded the ZIP package, look for the file 8203.bin—this is the firmware update you need.
Thanks, this helped a lot! I recently purchased the X34 module, which includes the cloud feature.
That means it's a new [product_name] with updated production status (FS). My [product_name] has FS X|2|3.
